combo_label: Tools & DIY × Magic & Illusion × The Wild West

entries.clue: Made-up story passed off as fact, like the Loch Ness photo
Hip pouch of stitched leather that keeps a pistol handy
Sequinned helper sawn in half nightly, who bows and walks off fine
Cowboy's broad-brimmed felt hat, the maker's surname now the word for it
Clear finish brushed on so the grain shows through a glassy shine
Little wooden peg that sits in a bored hole to marry two boards
Heavy-headed striker, its back end forked for levering fixings out
Looped rope a rider whirls overhead to catch a running calf
Send the crowd's gaze right while the real work happens left
Spread of grazing land where cattle are raised and rounded up
Swirling shoulder cloth, ideal for a dramatic swish
The magician's rapid talk, or the sound of rain on a window
Sworn second who pins on a tin star to back up the sheriff
